version.changelog: 零依赖纯前端碎片化文字收集/整理/导出 Word 单文件应用；支持编号条目、草稿箱、回收站、文件夹归档、一键导出 .docx。

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed local note-collection web app with Word export and no evidence of hidden network, credential, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The app is zero-dependency, front-end only, and uses browser APIs expected for its purpose: localStorage, FileReader for user-selected files, clipboard copy, and Blob downloads.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable installer is bundled; distribution is opening or sharing the HTML file, with an optional package_skill.py command for packaging.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill description includes broad trigger wording, including generic HTML-to-skill packaging language, which could cause over-selection, but the runtime instructions remain tied to the disclosed local app.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: User text, drafts, trash, and folder metadata/text persist in browser localStorage, which is disclosed and user-controlled through clear/delete actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a single-file front-end app for collecting text, organizing folders, and exporting .docx files; the bundled HTML implements those features coherently.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a local browser-based text board. Content and uploaded text files are stored in that browser's localStorage, so avoid storing highly sensitive material on shared machines and clear the app data when needed.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad invocation concern is supported by SKILL.md line 3 and line 17, but it is a scope-quality issue rather than evidence of hidden behavior or unsafe authority.
